div.div:
Seeded category with three interface labels.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
code: text [UQ NN]
name_kk: text [NN]
name_ru: text [NN]
name_en: text [NN]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (code)
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Lifecycle, time, access, capacity and calendar identity. No stored upcoming/completed
flag.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
organization_id: uuid [FK NN]
category_id: uuid [FK NN]
venue_id: uuid [FK NN]
venue_layout_id: uuid [FK ?]
title: text [NN]
description: text [NN]
publication_state: text [NN]
default 'draft'
moderation_state: text [NN]
default 'normal'
visibility: text [NN]
default 'public'
seating_mode: text [NN]
default 'general'
capacity: integer [NN]
starts_at: timestamptz [NN]
ends_at: timestamptz [NN]
time_zone: text [NN]
default 'Asia/Almaty'
registration_opens_at: timestamptz [NN]
registration_closes_at: timestamptz [NN]
admission_opens_at: timestamptz [NN]
admission_closes_at: timestamptz [NN]
refund_allowed: boolean [NN]
default true
refund_cutoff_at: timestamptz [?]
calendar_uid: text [UQ NN]
calendar_sequence: integer [NN]
default 0
availability_version: bigint [NN]
default 0
updated_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (calendar_uid)
UQ2: (id, organization_id)
UQ3: (id, venue_layout_id)
CK1: publication_state IN ('draft','published','unpublished','cancelled')
CK2: moderation_state IN ('normal','suspended')
CK3: visibility IN ('public','unlisted','private')
CK4: seating_mode IN ('general','assigned')
CK5: capacity >= 0
CK6: ends_at > starts_at
CK7: registration_closes_at > registration_opens_at AND registration_closes_at <= ends_at
CK8: admission_closes_at > admission_opens_at
CK9: NOT refund_allowed OR (refund_cutoff_at IS NOT NULL AND refund_cutoff_at <=
starts_at)
CK10: (seating_mode = 'assigned') = (venue_layout_id IS NOT NULL)
CK11: calendar_sequence >= 0 AND availability_version >= 0
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(venue_layout_id, venue_id) -> venue_layout(id, venue_id) [0..1 parent / 0..* children]
(category_id) -> category(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(venue_id) -> venue(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(organization_id) -> organization(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Account-specific invitation/access grant for private event.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
event_id: uuid [FK NN]
user_id: uuid [FK NN]
granted_by_user_id: uuid [FK NN]
revoked_at: timestamptz [?]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (event_id, user_id)
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(event_id) -> event(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(user_id) -> app_user(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(granted_by_user_id) -> app_user(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.

div.div:
Ordered event images; storage lifecycle separate from publication.
ATTRIBUTES (NN required / ? nullable)
id: uuid [PK NN]
default gen_random_uuid()
event_id: uuid [FK NN]
file_id: uuid [FK NN]
sort_order: integer [NN]
default 0
alt_text: text [NN]
created_at: timestamptz [NN]
default CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
CONSTRAINTS
UQ1: (event_id, sort_order)
UQ2: (event_id, file_id)
CK1: sort_order >= 0
FOREIGN KEYS / UML ASSOCIATIONS
(event_id) -> event(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
(file_id) -> stored_file(id) [1 parent / 0..* children]
All FK deletes/updates: RESTRICT. See TX rules for cross-row guards.
